name: Salad Variations
subtitle: A la Mom
notes: Infinite salad variations possible, here are some of my ideas. A fun way to present salads is either on individual plates, or on a platter, with the greens as a bed, and the toppings spread in an artistic pattern on the top. Also, see Moroccan, Thai, and Asparagus-Orange-Chicken salads in this salad section.

items: Fruit of the season (even if only apples or oranges), usually not oranges and tomatoes together
Artichokes, greek olives, dried tomatoes, feta cheese (as available)
Chicken, or hamburger meat cooked with the spices in the gyro meat recipe
Dressing: 1 cup olive oil, ⅓ red wine vinegar, ¾ tsp salt, 1 clove minced garlic, 1 tsp Dijon mustard, 1 tsp basil, 1 tsp oregano, ½ tsp black pepper, about ¾ tsp sugar
Green onions, sprouts, snap peas, water chestnut, bok choy cabbage, oranges, almonds, crispy noodles (ramen, chow mein), as available
Taco seasoned ground beef or carnitas meat
Italian dressing (or one made with a yummy salsa)
Blue or Swiss cheese, or both
Balsamic vinaigrette: ⅓ cup olive oil, 3 Tbsp balsamic vinegar, 1 Tbsp Dijon mustard, 1 garlic clove, ¼ tsp salt, ⅛ tsp pepper
Dressing: 3 parts olive oil, 1 part cider vinegar, salt, thyme, Dijon, pepper, and enough honey or sugar to sweeten it up just a bit
Good base with lots of tomatoes and avocados

steps.title: Start with a base
steps.body: First, start with a salad base. I aim to work through a bin of mixed greens every week. For almost all salads, I love to add cucumber (Persian are my favorite), red/yellow/orange pepper (sorry Lara), sliced carrot, some kind of onion (red or green, typically), and often tomato and avocado.

steps.title: Pick a theme
steps.body: Figure out a theme, based on other ingredients you may have, or something you’re hankering for, or a salad dressing you have. Some of my themes:

steps.title: Basic dinner
steps.body: Basic dinner meal–add cheese, raisins, sunflower seeds, ham/chicken, croutons, and a yummy ranch. Also, add fruit of the season–even if it’s only apples or oranges–but usually not oranges and tomatoes together.

steps.title: Mediterranean
steps.body: Mediterranean–add, as available, artichokes, greek olives, dried tomatoes, feta cheese, and either chicken, or hamburger meat cooked with the spices in the gyro meat recipe. For a dressing, **1 cup olive oil**, **⅓ red wine vinegar**, **¾ tsp salt**, **1 clove minced garlic**, **1 tsp Dijon mustard**, **1 tsp basil**, **1 tsp oregano**, **½ tsp black pepper**, and about **¾ tsp sugar**–just enough so the dressing isn’t too tangy. You also may want to just use the tzasiki dressing from the gyros recipe for the dressing.

steps.title: Asian
steps.body: Asian–no cucumbers or tomatoes or avocados, but do add, as available, green onions, sprouts, snap peas, water chestnut, bok choy cabbage, oranges, almonds, some kind of crispy noodle (ramen, chow mein), and top with an Asian sesame dressing.

steps.title: Taco
steps.body: Taco–Add taco seasoned ground beef or carnitas meat, shredded cheese, kidney beans, corn, chips, salsa and sour cream, and believe it or not, a good Italian dressing–or one made with a yummy salsa.

steps.title: Cobb
steps.body: Cobb–Add chicken, bacon crumbles, hard boiled eggs, blue or Swiss cheese or both. Mix up this balsamic vinaigrette dressing to top it off: **⅓ cup olive oil**, **3 Tbsp balsamic vinegar**, **1 Tbsp Dijon mustard**, **1 garlic clove**, **¼ tsp salt**, **⅛ tsp pepper**.

steps.title: Gourmet dinner
steps.body: Gourmet dinner–amp up the spinach, and add chicken and/or bacon, nuts (may be candied), dried cranberries, feta cheese, and red onion. (Leave out carrots and tomatoes.) Serve with the “Pink Dressing” or with the balsamic vinaigrette.

steps.title: Channahon special
steps.body: Channahon special–(inspired by Aldi’s Apple Cider Thyme dressing–but if that’s not around, you can whip up your own). Use greens, apples, chicken if desired, and feta or goat cheese. Mix up a dressing of **3 parts olive oil**, **1 part cider vinegar**, salt, thyme, Dijon, pepper, and enough honey or sugar to sweeten it up just a bit.

steps.title: Steak
steps.body: Steak–Cook up some delicious steak (medium to medium-rare), serve it over a good base with lots of tomatoes and avocados, oranges or apples, and add blue or feta or Swiss cheese.
